eyebrow: Lesson 08 · B1 · Good Manners at School · 20 câu
heading: Healthy and Fair
source: Bài đọc phỏng theo Good Manners at School – Ann Ingalls (The Child's World, 2013), tr. 16–21.
credit: Tranh minh hoạ: Ronnie Rooney, trong Good Manners at School (The Child's World, 2013). Dùng cho mục đích học tập.

paras.label: A
paras.text: Sometimes you feel a little {unwell|unwell}, but not ill enough to stay at home. On those days, {protect|protect} the people around you. Cover your mouth when you cough and your nose when you {sneeze|sneeze}, then say "Excuse me." If you are really sick, though, it is better to stay at home and rest.

paras.label: B
paras.text: Shared things need extra care. Many people use the drinking fountain, so never drop rubbish or gum into it, and keep your mouth away from the {spout|spout}. That way, your {germs|germs} stay with you. Keep the toilets clean, too, and always wash your hands with soap after using them.

paras.label: C
paras.text: Break time on the playground is the {highlight|highlight} of the day for many students, but it is also a place to practise fairness. {Have a go|have a go} on the swings, then let someone else have a turn while you move on to the slide. If another child is on the {climbing frame|climbing frame}, wait patiently; your turn will come soon.

paras.label: D
paras.text: Never push anyone. Nobody likes a {bully|bully}. Instead, {include|include} others and invite them to play. Games are usually more fun with more people, and if you are kind, others will be kind to you.

paras.label: E
paras.text: School is the perfect place to practise good manners. They make it easier to learn, eat, play and, most importantly, make friends. Use them everywhere, in class, in the lunchroom and on the playground, and you might just {earn|earn} an A+ for politeness!

parts.title: Part 1 · Which paragraph?
parts.instr: Đoạn nào (A–E) chứa thông tin dưới đây?

items.label: A paragraph that explains when staying at home is the right choice
items.why: Đoạn A: *If you are really sick… stay at home.*

items.label: A paragraph that gives advice about using a drinking fountain
items.why: Đoạn B: không bỏ rác, không ngậm vòi.

items.label: A paragraph that describes how to share playground equipment
items.why: Đoạn C: xích đu, cầu trượt, khung leo.

items.label: A paragraph that mentions a person nobody likes

parts.title: Part 2 · Reading comprehension
parts.instr: Chọn đáp án đúng hoặc True / False.

questions.q: What should you say after you sneeze?
The writer says you should go to school even when you are very sick.
questions.why: Sai. *If you are really sick… stay at home and rest.*

questions.q: Why should you keep your mouth away from the spout?
options: so that your germs don't pass to other people
so that the water stays cold
because the spout is too high
questions.why: *That way, your germs stay with you.*

questions.q: In paragraph C, the playground is described as a place to…
options: be the first on every ride
questions.why: *…it is also a place to practise fairness.*

questions.q: The writer believes games are usually more enjoyable when more people join in.
questions.why: Đúng. *Games are usually more fun with more people.*

questions.q: Why does the writer say "Nobody likes a bully"?
options: to explain why you shouldn't push other children
to describe the best playground game
questions.why: Câu này giải thích lý do *Never push anyone*.

questions.q: What does "you might just earn an A+ for politeness" suggest?
options: People will think you are very polite.
You will get a real mark for manners.
questions.why: Cách nói vui: được "điểm A+" về lịch sự = được mọi người đánh giá rất cao.

parts.title: Part 3 · Picture tasks
parts.instr: Quan sát tranh minh hoạ trong sách và trả lời.

questions.q: Which advice is the girl following?
options: Wash your hands with soap after using the toilet.
Keep your mouth away from the spout.
Cover your nose when you sneeze.
Stay at home when you are sick.
questions.why: Đúng lời khuyên cuối đoạn B.
questions.alt: A girl washing her hands with soap at a sink

questions.q: What is the best advice for the children on the swings, according to paragraph C?
options: Have a go, then let someone else have a turn.
Stay on the swing for the whole break.
Push others off so you can go higher.
Only play with your best friend.
questions.why: *Have a go on the swings, then let someone else have a turn.*
questions.alt: Three children happily on the swings together

questions.q: Which paragraph does this picture connect to?
questions.why: Đoạn E nhắc tới *an A+ for politeness*.
questions.alt: A smiling girl holding up a paper with an A+ on it

parts.title: Part 4 · Gapped text
parts.instr: Đọc đoạn văn ngắn và chọn câu phù hợp cho mỗi chỗ trống. Có 2 câu thừa.
parts.text: During break, a group of us were waiting for the swings. [1] Then Tuan came running and pushed his way to the front. [2] To our surprise, Tuan said sorry and went to the end of the line. [3]
options: Everyone was standing patiently in a line.
"Hey, we're all waiting for a turn," said Linh calmly.
After that, we all played together and had a great time.
Linh pushed him off the swing and laughed.
We decided to go home early.

items.why: Mô tả cảnh mọi người xếp hàng – tương phản với việc Tuan chen lên.
Linh nhắc nhở nhẹ nhàng → Tuan xin lỗi ở câu sau.
Kết thúc vui: mọi người cùng chơi.

parts.title: Part 5 · Words in context
parts.instr: Đoán nghĩa của từ/cụm từ dựa vào ngữ cảnh.

questions.q: *Have a go on the swings* (C). **Have a go** means…
questions.why: **Have a go** = chơi một lượt, thử.

questions.q: *Break time… is the highlight of the day* (C). The **highlight** is…
options: the best or most exciting part

questions.q: *Instead, include others* (D). To **include** someone is to…
questions.why: **Include** = cho tham gia cùng, trái nghĩa với *leave out*.
